01

“[they know] what is apparent of the worldly life, but they are…”

Two explanations transmitted from Ibrāhīm (Q 30:7).

761
Explanation from Ibrāhīm No. 761: 1

Ibrāhīm

English
Transmission wording
761: 1. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Ibrahim:
"[they know] what is apparent of the worldly life, but they are heedless of the Hereafter": He said, the Jews, the Christians, and the polytheists know what is beneficial to them and profits them in their worldly livelihoods, but they are heedless of the Hereafter (verse 7).
العربية
761: 1 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ظاهرا من الحياة الدنيا أوهم عن الأخرة هم غافلون قَالَ الْيَهُودُ وَالنَّصَارَى وَالْمُشْرِكُونَ يَعْلَمُونَ مَا يَرْفِقُ بِهِمْ وَيَنْفَعُهُمْ فِي مَعَايِشِهِمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ الآخرة هم غافلون (الآية 7) .

762
Report No. 762: 2

Report 762

English
762: 2. Sufyan, from his father, from Ikrima, the same.
العربية
762: 2 سفيان عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ مِثْلِهِ.

02

“what you give in usury to increase [your wealth] through the wealth…”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 30:39).

763
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 763: 3

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
763: 3. Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words
"what you give in usury to increase [your wealth] through the wealth of people does not increase with God": He said, they are gifts (verse 39).
العربية
763: 3 سفيان عن بن أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ وَمَا آتَيْتُمْ مِنْ رِبًا ليربوا في أموال الناس فلا يربوا عند الله قال هي الهدايا (الآية 39) .
Edition record 371476 · p. 237Link to report ↗
764
Report from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr No. 764: 4

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
764: 4. Sufyan, from Mansur ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Said ibn Jubayr, who said:
It is the man who gives gifts in order to be repaid for them.
العربية
764: 4 سفيان عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ هُوَ الرَّجُلُ يُعْطِي الْعَطَايَا لِيُثَابَ عليها.

03

“corruption has appeared on land and sea”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 30:41).

765
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 765: 5

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
765: 5. Sufyan, from Layth, from Mujahid, on His words
"corruption has appeared on land and sea": He said, on land the killing of the son of Adam, and at sea the seizing of ships by force (verse 41).
العربية
765: 5 سُفْيَانُ عَنْ لَيْثٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ في قوله الفساد في البر والبحر قال في البر قتل بن آدم وفي البحر أخذ السفيانة غصبا (الآية 41) .
